title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Faculty of Science Campus Transfer Policy
To request a transfer from one campus to another in
Faculty
of Science
programs
, students must complete and submit the Faculty of Science Campus Transfer Request Form.
Students
who have completed 4.0 credits
, meeting
minimum program transfer requirements
, will be eligible to transfer campuses if there is space in the academic program to allow students to meet their degree requirements. All campus transfers into a Faculty of Science program are at the discretion of the Faculty of Science.
